Indie Assemble is a week-long Steam event spotlighting incredible indie games from around the world. Hosted by Excalibur in collaboration with Rome Video Game Lab, the event celebrates the creativity, culture, and community that power indie development. Dive into a curated collection of standout titles, support indie developers, and uncover hidden gems [many with special event discounts!].

The unknown awaits.

notes.title: Dive Into Our Demo During Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[b][h2]We're excited to announce that the Cold Abyss Demo will be playable throughout Steam Next Fest! 🌊🎉[/h2][/b]
[previewyoutube=RVCo5hltW44;full][/previewyoutube]
To our early explorers: Thank you for your initial feedback - it's already helping us making your walk under the ocean more... relaxing.

To our fresh divers: It's your turn to descend from [b]now until March 3rd[/b].. Whether it’s peace you’re looking for, or something else: The dark depths of the ocean are the perfect place to unwind after a long day.

There’s nobody down there... Only you. [b]Trust us[/b].

[b][h3]What can you expect in Cold Abyss?[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] An atmospheric experience where you walk on the ocean floor with nothing but a GPS, a flashlight, and a portable cable repair machine.
[*] Don’t worry, it’s completely free and safe, courtesy of Tachibana Heavy Industries!
[/list]
Good luck, divers... you'll need it.

~ Neon Doctrine

notes.title: Demo Update Ver 1.1
notes.content:
Attention, divers!

Headquarters at Tachibana Heavy Industries has demanded we address some of the issues you encountered during your time on the ocean floor. 

Our technical team has managed to resolve the following:
[list]
[*] Unable to return to the main menu after finishing the demo, [b]fixed[/b]
[*] Unable to repair the cables using a controller, [b]fixed[/b]
[/list]
We would like to remind you that once you've entered our service, you may find it difficult to leave. 

Being trapped in the depths is only an illusion... or is it?

(jk we'll fix it so you can exit the game asap we swear)

~ Neon Doctrine

notes.title: 🌊🦑Cold Abyss Reveal - Solitude in Submerged Serenity.
notes.content:
[h3]We're excited to share that the expanded version of Cold Abyss is officially coming to Steam![/h3]

This version is packed with:
🔹 New levels and an expanded story
🔹 Improved graphics and smoother movement
🔹 All-new collectibles to discover

If you’re ready to escape to the loneliest (and most peaceful) place on Earth, hit that wishlist button—it helps more than you know!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3260040/Cold_Abyss_Directors_Cut/

(P.S. Publishing a game about walking along the ocean floor means I have to go diving for research, right? Asking for science. 😉)


[i]Your job is simple: fix some internet cables. 
The catch? They’re underwater. 
Very. Deep. 
Underwater.[/i]
